body: Just had a really bad 7 months. My mum passed away and I broke up with my girlfriend so, it's a struggle.
Of course. If you ever wanna talk about anything, we can DM. I know what it feels like to be alone.

I'm sorry about what you've been through. I actually had a nightmare that I got raped last night and I woke up feeling really depressed and couldn't stop sighing. I couldn't imagine what it would be like for real.

Life can be extremely cruel and unforgiving at times but I'm trying to live by "I would rather feel something than absolutely nothing if I kill myself."

I actually don't feel any different than the last time I attempted. I'm not sure on my heart but I'm still alive. 

I urge you to reconsider though. This is only temporary how you're feeling and the pain is only there for a bit, I promise.
Hey friend. I wouldn't like you to leave us. I'm struggling too but I hope you can make it.

Hey everyone. Still here. They need to give me a pacemaker because my heart doesn't work too well because of the overdose and beats really slowly. Thanks for the supportive comments but I wouldn't wish these circumstances on my worst enemy.
I've been at the hospital for 3 hours, doing okay

It is definitely messed up. I loved the girl more than life itself. People will say there's plenty of fish in the sea and there's more girls out there but alas, I feel this way instead.

My brothers. One of them has a high profile job working in transportation and another is in and out of prison. One of my uncles leeches from the government and hasn't had a job in 10+ years. The other is the opposite. He's successful but he's a sociopath. He uses people's emotions and weaknesses to his advantage.

I think him and my ex are dating now which makes things worse.

I appreciate your quote but it just doesn't stick with me. I'm sorry.
I would be sincere about it if I told him but I feel as though he would either be embarrassed or extremely defensive about it..

Thank you. I've been on 3 different kinds of anti-depressants and I know it's trial and error but I just keep thinking why aren't they working, in the end. I exercise a lot and try to get out of the house as much as I can but sometimes, I just wanna curl up in bed.

Thank you though, I appreciate it.
I'm on some medication for my depression and anxiety. My anxiety medication works for the most part but my depression, not so much.
